reply: perature dependence changes with strain: the local power of T is about 2.5 at eps≈0.5 and about 1 at eps≈3–4. Per-temperature fits of c·eps^n + d also left 7–12% residuals, so the simple Ludwik/Hollomon forms I tried don't capture it. The tool budget ran out before I could test a more physical form.
